posts.cooked:
Hi.

 

If you don't have Villains of the Multiverse, can you still make use of all the Villains of the Multiverse mini expansions? Like the Wager Master?

 

Thanks.

posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked: Yes, all mini- expansions can be played with just the core game.
posts.raw: Yes, all mini- expansions can be played with just the core game.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Villains adds 10 Vengeance style decks that you can use to play the vengeance format, you don't need the Vengeance game to play it.

It also comes with 4 environments that can be played in any game, in any format.

The mini-expansion Villain is a solo villain, it can be played with any other sets, and the Mini-expansion environment as well.
